blurb: Travel North on I-95 in New Hampshire to Exit 5, (Portsmouth traffic circle and Rt. 1 South). Bear right onto Rt. 1 South and drive 2 miles to the intersection of Elwyn Rd. /Rt. 1A South. Take a left onto Route 1A South/ Elwyn Rd. and continue for 1 1/2 miles until you reach the 3-way intersection, turn left onto Rt. 1A North (Sagamore Road). Continue on Rt 1A North, make a right onto Route 1B (Wentworth Road).
